limitations: Real nonempty density results cover CPU and thread-state only; named slices/counters unavailable and frames empty. All four color identity cases are additionally covered by independent frozen Swift success vectors.
Utilization/occupied values are unavailable in current native density output; fractional utilization and nullable/Int64 edge fields are decoder/Core-copy unit evidence only.
Core density copies are caller-owned; capacity credits cover SDK packed arrays/UTF8 and fixed policy overhead, not Foundation internals or measured allocator/RSS.
Original Swift child process outputs and DB SHA are retained; its exact transient Ready pathname/argv was not separately logged. Outer producer/build/gate commands have explicit receipts.
One real source prepare produced the new separate private Ready copy; controlled copying-parser byte validation is not an SDK native-open or owner-pressure acceptance result.
No batch per-query deadline transport or typed batch owner, shared repository adapter, App cutover, signed release or full macOS acceptance.
